protocol.selection: Sort each original frozen500 by SHA256([seed,native-updates-A-v1,task,question_id,image_sha256,prompt_ids]); first100. No output-dependent selection.
protocol.sharding: Reuse original image-bound physical GPU rank; same image always one GPU.
protocol.intervention: NONE. Native prompt only, no Decode, cache or ablation. One forward/question in formal collection.
protocol.query: Actual last valid Prompt query P-1; preserve original input mapping.
protocol.arithmetic: Capture actual FP16 vectors at five hooks; all norms, dot products, sums for statistics and cosines in FP32 on CPU.
protocol.residual_check: Actual h_mid must equal FP16-round(h_in+A) bit-exactly, and h_out=FP16-round(h_mid+M). Also record FP32 sum errors with fixed FP16 eps=2^-10 and min-subnormal=2^-24 bound.
protocol.historical: Strict task/question/layer join of old BOS and Delta LogP CSVs; retain old500 curve separately from matched100.

bootstrap.estimator: Question-weighted resampled whole-image sums/counts. Overview pools600 questions (equal100/task at observed cohort), retaining cross-task shared images.
bootstrap.interval: Ordinary paired95% CI, descriptive; no multiplicity-adjusted significance, equivalence or causal claims.

planned_contrasts: early MLP ratio minus Attention ratio
protocol.zero_policy: Reject near-zero h_in denominator; undefined zero-vector cosine/cancellation are null, not imputed0. Record valid counts.
protocol.raw: Actual five-vector FP16 arrays and Full FP32 vocabulary logits saved externally with SHA256; replay all measurements.
